title: Capitol City Circus School

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Our Circus summer camp gives children of all levels the opportunity to run away and join the circus for a week! They will spend the first part of the week sampling the circus arts we offer, including flying trapeze, aerial arts, juggling, and trampoline. Then they will choose a focus and build a routine for their end of week performance. Just like any great camp experience, campers will get to build teamwork and leadership skills, foster their independence, and have lots of fun! services.name: gymnastics page
services.desc: Welcome to Cap City Gymnastics, where children discover the joy of gymnastics beneath the soaring canopy of Washington, DC's iconic big top. As a USA Gymnastics Member Club, our experienced instructors offer recreational and pre-competitive classes for children ages 12 months through 9 years. Our structured curriculum guides each child through progressive skill development in small classes designed to build strength, awareness, confidence, and a lifelong love of movement. Beyond the traditional gymnastics events, students catch glimpses of flying trapeze, aerial silks, and the vibrant energy of a full-scale circus school.
